title: Legacy Pteranodon: Fossils And Archeology
description: A resource pack that aims to addapt the original F.A Pteranodon to the newer version of the mod
body:
This resource pack was carefully developed to adapt the original look and feel of the classic F.A. Pteranodon, ensuring it works and looks compatible great within the 1.18.2 - 1.20.1  version of the mod.
